Dear [Madam](/person/2166)
I am very sorry I cannot help you to [Ben Sylvester](/book/25). I have not even one of my own except in a bound up volume, and the copyright is not mine. But if you enquired for it direct from [Innes](/person/744)they might find a last copy, or be stirred to a reprint.

yours truly

C M Yonge
